hero.headline: Abstract Architecture
hero.subheadline: We develop innovative and sustainable solutions for your construction projects – from the first idea to final implementation.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: Get to know us
story.p1: For many years, Wir Ingenieurgesellschaft mbH has stood for innovation and quality in real estate and project development. In addition to property sales, we specialize in the development of land and areas that combine commercial and residential real estate.
story.p2: With passion and expertise, we venture into niches, identify trends early and bring them to market maturity with well-thought-out concepts. Our goal is to create sustainable and forward-thinking solutions that add value for our clients and society.

services.label: Our Services
services.title: Expertise across all service phases
services.description: WIR accompanies your real estate project from the first idea to final implementation – competent, reliable and with a clear focus on your goals. As an experienced engineering firm, we cover all HOAI service phases 1–8.

items.title: Site Analysis
items.description: Systematic evaluation of location, potential and market environment for optimal baseline determination.

items.title: Strategic Concept
items.description: Development of forward-thinking usage concepts with a focus on economic efficiency and sustainability.

items.title: Construction Planning & Implementation
items.description: Professional planning and realization of all service phases according to HOAI 1–8.

items.title: Expert Assessment
items.description: Independent expert services for real estate valuation and structural engineering questions.

team.label: About Us
team.title: The team behind your projects
team.description: Our team consists of experienced architects and engineers who work with passion and commitment on innovative solutions. Together we combine creativity, precision and a deep understanding of architecture and construction planning.

members.name: Hoda Fakharian
members.bio: Passionate architect with over 17 years of experience. Master's degree, member of the Chamber of Architects. Focus on innovative, sustainable and aesthetic designs that combine functionality and creativity.

members.name: Dipl.-Ing. Amir Schojai M.Sc.
members.bio: Experienced structural engineer with over 40 years of expertise. Authorized building engineer, certified real estate appraiser, site management and fire protection planning (TÜV Rheinland).

members.name: Hamed Sabeti
members.bio: Electrical engineer with 25 years of experience. Specialized in innovative solutions – from planning and implementing complex electrical systems to developing efficient and sustainable concepts.

projects.label: Our Projects

projects.description: Here we present a selection of our successfully completed projects. Each project reflects our passion, expertise and commitment to delivering exceptional results.
